events.title: Zoe becomes Byzantine empress with Romanos III
events.description: As her father Constantine VIII lay dying, Zoe was married to Romanos III, who became emperor. She went on to share the throne with three husbands, an adopted son and her sister Theodora.

events.title: Jules Léotard performs the first flying trapeze act
events.description: At the Cirque Napoléon in Paris, Jules Léotard swung between trapezes in the first flying trapeze act. The close-fitting garment he wore still bears his name.
events.html: At the Cirque Napoléon in Paris, Jules Léotard swung between trapezes in the first flying trapeze act. The close-fitting garment he wore still bears his name.

events.title: Searchers find the tent of Scott's polar party
events.description: A search party found the snow-covered tent containing the bodies of Robert Falcon Scott and two companions, eight months after their deaths returning from the South Pole. Scott's diary told their story.
events.html: A search party found the snow-covered tent containing the bodies of Robert Falcon Scott and two companions, eight months after their deaths returning from the South Pole. Scott's diary told their story.

events.title: Austria is proclaimed a republic
events.description: A day after Emperor Charles I renounced participation in state affairs, the provisional national assembly in Vienna proclaimed the Republic of German-Austria. Habsburg rule there, dating from 1278, was over.
events.html: A day after Emperor Charles I renounced participation in state affairs, the provisional national assembly in Vienna proclaimed the Republic of German-Austria. Habsburg rule there, dating from 1278, was over.

events.title: The Bhola cyclone devastates East Pakistan
events.description: A cyclone and storm surge struck the coast of East Pakistan, killing perhaps 300,000 to 500,000 people. Anger at the government's response fed the movement that led to Bangladesh's independence.
